limitations: 39MOS macro only: no pad/ESD/package/other digital cells/POR or optical qualification.
All external passives and rail ideal-source contracts explicit. Pin-level fault/recovery from actual RTL simulation, not storage transistors in macro.
Extracted model geometry or distributed R/C scope follows selected DUT file and physical manifest.
All startup cases assume VSAFE/VBUF/LED prepowered and external fault high.

selected_solver_rules.startup: All10 startup cases are from the full40us integer-tick0.1ps local-grid run, not a mixture cherry-picked per passing result. Linear rail function unchanged.
selected_solver_rules.normal_fault: All3 fault and4normal cases are from original full17case run. Their circuit, rail, resistor and capacitor inputs are identical to startup-grid run.
selected_solver_rules.scope: Actual39MOS fullRC macro+actualRTL pin replay; not full system silicon qualification.
